doc.title: Kenny Davern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001 [interview 2 of 2]

title: Ruby Braff's signature sound
summary: He calls Ruby Braff a strongly individual, humorous player recognizable within four bars.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: Ruby is very, very strong individual player. I’ve known him a long time and on and off, you know I mean, very humorous, wild sense of humor, loves to hold court and does, and an unsung hero in a way, I mean among people that know, know that he is a very individual, within four bars you know it’s him, he’s got his own signature so to speak, has a big, strong part in a world of millions and millions of clones and sound-alikes. To be able to tell a person within four bars, oh that’s so-and-so, I mean that’s an amazing feat to be able to do that.
